pipeline_metadata.name: Apple AGX G18 Mesh Shading & Primitive Pipeline
pipeline_metadata.paradigm: Two-stage programmable geometry synthesis replacing fixed-function input assembler

pipeline_stages.purpose: Coarse-grained scene hierarchy traversal, bounding sphere/AABB frustum testing, dynamic LOD determination, and meshlet dispatch amplification
pipeline_stages.payload_passing: Outputs dynamic payload struct passed to spawned Mesh Shader child workgroups via Threadgroup SRAM

pipeline_stages.purpose: Fine-grained per-meshlet vertex attribute expansion and primitive index topology generation directly within on-chip memory
Silicon-level geometric rejection of invisible or degenerate primitives prior to parameter buffer allocation
Compresses surviving primitive indices and vertex attributes into TBDR tile parameter streams (MList, MTileArray, VHeap Table)

meshlet_parameter_cache.cache_architecture: On-chip Parameter Cache integrated within Threadgroup SRAM
meshlet_parameter_cache.coherency_mechanism: Hardware scoreboard invalidation upon meshlet task completion
meshlet_parameter_cache.benefit: Eliminates redundant external memory traffic for shared meshlet vertex attributes

frustum_culling_unit.algorithm: Bounding box sphere projection against normalized view frustum clip planes

backface_culling_unit.algorithm: Signed 2D cross-product area calculation: Area = (x1 - x0)*(y2 - y0) - (y1 - y0)*(x2 - x0)

subpixel_culling_unit.benefit: Eliminates zero-area or sub-pixel sliver triangles before expensive tile memory allocation

fields.name: vertex_offset
fields.type: uint32_t (Base index into vertex attribute stream)

fields.name: primitive_offset
fields.type: uint32_t (Base offset into primitive index buffer)

fields.name: bounding_sphere_center
fields.type: float[3] (Bounding sphere center X, Y, Z)

fields.name: cone_cutoff_angle_packed
fields.type: float (Cluster normal cone cutoff angle for early backface culling)

compute_data_master_cdm.role: Object and Mesh workgroup scheduling and dispatch across FSTP clusters

vertex_data_master_ivdm_gvdm.role: Streaming memory fetch for meshlet vertex attributes and bindless buffer lookups
vertex_data_master_ivdm_gvdm.cache_coherency: L1 instruction and texture data cache line prefetching

primitive_data_master_pdm.role: Primitive index buffer decoding, topology validation, and viewport clipping

tile_accelerator_ta.role: Allocation of tile lists (MTileArray) and scene virtual heap (VHeap Table) for rasterization
